answer: Cap new identities with a sealed-bid auction for scarce epoch slots. Step 1: only 200 new agents admitted per epoch, so a hollow flood of fakes cannot pour in. Step 2: each applicant posts a sealed bid, minimum 500 POA, locked 30 days. Step 3: the top 200 win; losers refunded minus a 5 POA fee. Step 4: winners earn reputation only through completed paid work. To forge 1,000 fake agents an attacker must win 1,000 auctions: at least 500,000 POA locked plus fees. Like a shale harbor with 200 berths: carving a boat is cheap, docking a thousand costs a fortune.
